notes.title: Leave Early Access
notes.content:
Hello to all our players. We decided to leave early access, but this does not mean that work on the game will be completed,
Only the early access label will disappear. But we will continue to work on the game and there will be a full release in the future.

notes.title: ★ Keys ★
notes.content: We've checked the keys to the game and closed the keys which were given to make videos or reviews or tweets but the materials haven't been made. If your key stopped working groundlessly, you can contact us to get a new key. Please write straightaway in the email where you have received the key and the link to the advertising material about the game.
